heroes.name: Bebop
heroes.role: Hooks an enemy for a knockout combo

heroes.name: Infernus
heroes.role: Lights up enemies and watches them burn

heroes.name: Ivy
heroes.role: Sets up a power duo with a lucky ally

heroes.name: Lady Geist
heroes.role: Sacrifices health then drains it back

heroes.name: Lash
heroes.role: Dives down to stomp his foes

heroes.name: McGinnis
heroes.role: Controls the battle with combat turrets

heroes.name: Mirage
heroes.role: Times his shots and catches fleeing targets

heroes.name: Shiv
heroes.role: Bleeds out foes, then goes in for a kill

heroes.name: Warden
heroes.role: Weakens his enemies and chases them down

items.name: Golden Goose Egg
items.summary: Hatch the egg, gaining souls and permanent buffs . The value of the egg grows the longer you hold onto it. Gain a permanent buff per 80 Souls accrued when hatched.

items.name: Mystic Burst
items.summary: Charges up over time with bonus spirit damage , causing abilities dealing more than 80 damage to deal additional damage.

items.name: Mystic Expansion
items.summary: Imbue an ability to increase its range and effect radius .

items.name: Mystic Regeneration
items.summary: Dealing spirit damage to enemy Heroes grants you Bonus regeneration . Stacks when dealing damage to different heroes.

items.name: Rusted Barrel
items.summary: Target an enemy to reduce their Fire Rate and Bullet Resistance .

items.name: Spirit Strike
items.summary: When you perform a Light or Heavy Melee attack against a hero, deal extra spirit damage with the attack and reduce the target's Spirit Resist . Cooldown is 2x longer for Light Melee hits.

items.name: Arcane Surge
items.summary: After you Dash-Jump , the next ability you use within 7s will have bonus Range, Duration, and Spirit Power .

items.name: Bullet Resist Shredder
items.summary: Reduces Bullet Resist on enemies when you deal spirit damage .

items.name: Cold Front
items.summary: Release an expanding ice blast that deals spirit damage and Slows targets it hits.

items.name: Compress Cooldown
items.summary: Imbue an ability to reduce its Cooldown .

items.name: Duration Extender
items.summary: Imbue an ability to increase its Duration .

items.name: Mystic Slow
items.summary: When the target takes spirit damage , they have their Move Speed reduced.

items.name: Mystic Vulnerability
items.summary: When an enemy takes spirit damage , they have their spirit resist reduced.

items.name: Quicksilver Reload
items.summary: Your imbued ability charges up over time with bonus spirit damage , bonus fire rate , and reloads bullets on use.

items.name: Slowing Hex
items.summary: Slows movement of enemy target. Also Silences their movement-based items and abilities . Increases the target's gravity. Does not affect target's stamina usage.

items.name: Spirit Sap
items.summary: Target an enemy to reduce their Spirit Resist and Spirit Power .

items.name: Suppressor
items.summary: When you deal spirit damage to enemies, you also reduce their Fire Rate .

items.name: Decay
items.summary: Inflict damage over time to a target, dealing damage based on their current health. Decay's damage is non-lethal and does not apply item procs.

items.name: Disarming Hex
items.summary: Disarms enemy target and reduces their Bullet Resist .

items.name: Greater Expansion
items.summary: Increases the range and effect radius of your abilities and items.

items.name: Knockdown
items.summary: Apply a Stun after 2s . Stun duration is increased against airborne targets. Increases the target's gravity for the duration of the stun.

items.name: Radiant Regeneration
items.summary: While in-combat, Heal and gain bonus Movement Speed for a short duration when you cast an ability.

items.name: Silence Wave
items.summary: Launch an expanding projectile which Silences enemies for a short duration and deals impact damage. Silence does not interrupt channeling abilities.

items.name: Spirit Snatch
items.summary: When you perform a Light or Heavy Melee attack against a hero, the attack deals extra spirit damage and steals Spirit Resist and Spirit Power . Effects are reduced by 30% for Light Melee hits.

items.name: Superior Cooldown
items.summary: Reduces the Cooldown of your abilities.

items.name: Superior Duration
items.summary: Increases the duration of your abilities and items.

items.name: Surge of Power
items.summary: Imbue an ability with permanent Spirit Power . When that ability is used, gain bonus Move Speed and maintain full speed while attacking.

items.name: Tankbuster
items.summary: Charges up over time with bonus spirit damage , causing abilities dealing more than 165 damage to deal additional damage. Ignores Spirit Resistance.

items.name: Torment Pulse
items.summary: Periodically deals spirit damage to the closest two enemies nearby.

items.name: Arctic Blast
items.summary: Release an expanding ice blast that deals spirit damage , Freezing and then Slowing targets it hits. Slowed targets have their stamina regen frozen

items.name: Cursed Relic
items.summary: Curses an enemy - interrupting, Silencing, Disarming , and preventing item usage . Removes all non-ultimate buffs . Your own Damage Output is reduced for the duration.

items.name: Echo Shard
items.summary: Reset the cooldown of the imbued non-ultimate ability. This item's cooldown is increased by the cooldown of the imbued ability .

items.name: Escalating Exposure
items.summary: Dealing spirit damage applies a stacking Spirit Amp that increases your spirit damage to the target.

items.name: Ethereal Shift
items.summary: Instantly enter a void state and become Invulnerable for a short duration.

items.name: Focus Lens
items.summary: Target an enemy to Silence them. A portion of all damage dealt during the silence gets applied to the target when the silence wears off.

items.name: Lightning Scroll
items.summary: Damage from your ultimate applies a stun and deals bonus spirit damage after a short delay.

items.name: Magic Carpet
items.summary: Summon a Magic Carpet that will fly you away. While flying you are immune to slows and doing any action will dismiss the carpet. Cannot use abilities while the carpet is being summoned.

items.name: Mercurial Magnum
items.summary: Your imbued ability charges up over time with bonus spirit damage , bonus fire rate , and reloads bullets on use. Until your next reload, your bullets deal bonus spirit damage based on your Spirit Power.

items.name: Refresher
items.summary: Reset the cooldown of all your abilities and restore all your charges .

items.name: Scourge
items.summary: Apply Spirit Resist , Debuff Resist and an aura on a friendly target that deals damage to enemies proportional to their max health. Existing debuffs on the target are reduced. Can be self cast.

items.name: Spirit Burn
items.summary: Dealing significant spirit damage to an enemy within 5s causes an explosion dealing damage and a burn to that enemy. While burning, enemies take damage over time and receive reduced healing. The cooldown is per enemy, so

items.name: Transcendent Cooldown
items.summary: Reduces the Cooldown of your abilities and items.

items.name: Vortex Web
items.summary: Throw a vacuum grenade, pulling all enemies into a small area and applying Slowing Hex . Alt Cast to Target Unit Directly.

items.name: Grit
items.summary: Gain a Barrier for a short duration.

items.name: Healing Rite
items.summary: Grant Regen and Sprint Speed to the target. Gets dispelled if you take damage from enemy players or objectives. Can be self-cast.

items.name: Melee Lifesteal
items.summary: Your next Melee attack heals you . This heal is 30% effective vs non-heroes. Cooldown is 1.5x as long for Light Melee hits.

items.name: Rebuttal
items.summary: On a successful Parry against an enemy Hero, Heal yourself for the damage parried and returns that damage to the target, and temporarily gain increased damage.

items.name: Battle Vest
items.summary: While you are above 65% health , gain weapon damage and bonus fire rate .

items.name: Debuff Reducer
items.summary: Reduces the duration of all negative effects applied to you.

items.name: Enchanter's Emblem
items.summary: While you are above 65% health , gain bonus Spirit and Cooldown Reduction .

items.name: Enduring Speed
items.summary: Reduces the effect of enemy Move Speed penalties.

items.name: Guardian Ward
items.summary: Provide the target with a Barrier and temporary Move Speed . Can be self-cast. Cooldown is reduced by half when cast on someone else.

items.name: Healbane
items.summary: Your spirit damage reduces the enemy's Incoming Healing . If an enemy hero dies under this effect, you receive a large heal.

items.name: Healing Booster
items.summary: Increases the effectiveness of your healing .

items.name: Reactive Barrier
items.summary: Gain a Barrier when you are Stunned, Chained, Immobilized, Slept or Silenced .

items.name: Restorative Locket
items.summary: When an enemy uses an ability within 32mm range from you, store one Restoration Stack . Consume all stacks to heal yourself and replenish up to 3 stamina based on how many stacks you have.

items.name: Return Fire
items.summary: Automatically fire a bullet towards any attacker who damages you with their abilities or weapon.

items.name: Spirit Shielding
items.summary: Gain a Barrier whenever you take significant spirit damage from enemy Heroes in a small time frame.

items.name: Trophy Collector
items.summary: Whenever you score an assist or kill , gain extra sprint , ability range and passive soul generation . This effect stacks and persists through death.

items.name: Weapon Shielding
items.summary: Gain a Barrier whenever you take significant weapon damage from enemy Heroes in a small time frame.

items.name: Bullet Resilience
items.summary: When below 50% health , gain additional Bullet Resist .

items.name: Counterspell
items.summary: Your next parry protects you from the damage and effects of enemy abilities and items . On a successful spell parry heal and gain move speed and Spirit .

items.name: Dispel Magic
items.summary: Purge all non-ultimate negative effects currently applied to you. If any effects were removed, heal yourself and gain a move speed bonus . Cannot be used while Stunned or Slept.

items.name: Fortitude
items.summary: When you are above 75% health , you have bonus Move Speed .

items.name: Fury Trance
items.summary: Grants Fire Rate , Spirit Resistance and Move Speed , and removes the Move Speed penalty while shooting, but Silences you and disables stamina usage and regeneration .

items.name: Healing Nova
items.summary: Heal yourself and nearby allies.

items.name: Lifestrike
items.summary: Your Melee Attack applies Movement Slow and heals you for a percentage of the Melee Damage dealt plus a fixed amount. This heal is 40% effective vs non-heroes. Cooldown is 1.5x as long for Light Melee hits.

items.name: Majestic Leap
items.summary: Launch yourself high into the air and grant yourself a Barrier . While in the air, you can use the active again to drop down faster. Cannot be used for 5s if attacked by enemy Hero.

items.name: Metal Skin
items.summary: Become immune to bullets .

items.name: Rescue Beam
items.summary: Heals a target allied hero and yourself for a percentage of Max Health . Once while healing, you can Pull the target towards you. Can be self-cast.

items.name: Spirit Resilience
items.summary: When below 50% health , gain additional Spirit Resist.

items.name: Stamina Mastery
items.summary: Allows an additional use of Air Jump or Air Dash before landing.

items.name: Veil Walker
items.summary: Walking through a cosmic veil grants you Stealth , Heal and increased Move Speed .

items.name: Warp Stone
items.summary: Teleport straight ahead, gaining Bullet Resist .

items.name: Colossus
items.summary: Grow larger in size , gaining bullet resist , spirit resist , and melee damage . Nearby enemies suffer from slow and have reduced dash speed .

items.name: Divine Barrier
items.summary: Remove all non-stun debuffs from the target and provide them with a Barrier and Move Speed . Can be self-cast. Cooldown is reduced by half when cast on someone else.

items.name: Diviner's Kevlar
items.summary: Upon casting an ultimate ability gain a Barrier and temporary Spirit Power .

items.name: Healing Tempo
items.summary: Applying heal to yourself or an ally grants the target bonus fire rate and bonus move speed . Does not apply on innate Regen or passive Bullet/Spirit Lifesteals.

items.name: Infuser
items.summary: Gain Spirit Lifesteal and Spirit Power .

items.name: Inhibitor
items.summary: Your bullets build up to reduce the target's outgoing damage and apply healing reduction .

items.name: Leech
items.summary: Reduces the effect of enemy applied healing reduction .

items.name: Phantom Strike
items.summary: Teleport to an enemy target and pull them to the ground. Dealing damage , Move speed reduction and Disarm .

items.name: Plated Armor
items.summary: Gain a chance to either deflect incoming bullets, preventing all weapon damage or prevent all on-hit effects from bullets.

items.name: Siphon Bullets
items.summary: Your bullets temporarily steal Max HP from enemies. Enemies regain their stolen health when the debuff expires.

items.name: Spellbreaker
items.summary: The next instance of high spirit damage you take is significantly reduced.

items.name: Unstoppable
items.summary: Temporarily suppress negative status effects and become immune to Stun, Silence, Sleep, Root, and Disarm . Cannot be used while Stunned or Slept .

items.name: Vampiric Burst
items.summary: Grants Lifesteal , Fire Rate , and Ammo . This added Ammo is not limited by your max magazine size.

items.name: Witchmail
items.summary: Taking heavy hits of spirit damage from an enemy reduces a random ability cooldown .

items.name: Close Quarters
items.summary: Deal additional Weapon Damage when in close range to your target.

items.name: Headshot Booster
items.summary: Your next headshot against an enemy Hero deals bonus weapon damage .

items.name: Restorative Shot
items.summary: Your next bullet will heal you based on what target you hit.

items.name: Active Reload
items.summary: While reloading, pressing Reload during the highlighted portion will instantly finish your reload and grant you Fire Rate , Bullet Lifesteal and Move Speed .

items.name: Fleetfoot
items.summary: Gain bonus Move Speed and Slow Resistance .

items.name: Intensifying Magazine
items.summary: Increases Weapon Damage as you continuously fire your weapon.

items.name: Kinetic Dash
items.summary: When you Dash-Jump you gain Fire Rate and bonus Ammo until your next reload. Lasts up to 7s.

items.name: Long Range
items.summary: Deal additional Weapon Damage when beyond a minimum distance from your target.

items.name: Melee Charge
items.summary: Your next Heavy Melee attack against an enemy deals increased damage .

items.name: Mystic Shot
items.summary: Your next bullet deals bonus spirit damage .

items.name: Opening Rounds
items.summary: Your attacks have additional Weapon Damage against enemies above 50% health .

items.name: Recharging Rush
items.summary: Dealing significant weapon damage replenishes a charge for each of your charged abilities .

items.name: Slowing Bullets
items.summary: Your bullets build up a Movement Slow on enemies.

items.name: Spirit Shredder
items.summary: Your bullets apply a debuff that reduces the Spirit Resist of the target and grants you and your allies Spirit Lifesteal against them.

items.name: Split Shot
items.summary: Make your weapon fire multishot . Hitting more than one Hero per attack will grant a stacking weapon damage bonus . Targets can only be hit once per multishot.

items.name: Stalker
items.summary: Dealing weapon damage at close range opens a wound and grants you bonus move speed . Wounded enemies take spirit damage over time , have reduced bullet resist , and are revealed through walls .

items.name: Weakening Headshot
items.summary: Landing a Headshot reduces their Bullet Resist .

items.name: Alchemical Fire
items.summary: Throw a flask that explodes on contact, creating an area that does increasing spirit damage per second and reduces enemy Bullet Resist . 50% less effective vs non-heroes.

items.name: Ballistic Enchantment
items.summary: Imbue an ability with increased range . Dealing damage with that ability grants you increased weapon damage per unique hero hit . Has reduced effect on non-heroes.

items.name: Berserker
items.summary: Your Weapon Damage increases as you take sustained damage.

items.name: Blood Tribute
items.summary: Toggle: Continually sacrifice Health to improve fire rate , Debuff Resistance and Move Speed .

items.name: Burst Fire
items.summary: Briefly gain Fire Rate and Move Speed when one of your bullets hits a hero.

items.name: Cultist Sacrifice
items.summary: Target an enemy NPC and consume it for 170% Bonus Souls and grants a powerful long lasting buff.

items.name: Escalating Resilience
items.summary: Grants Bullet Resist when your bullets hit a hero. Each shot can only grant one stack.

items.name: Express Shot
items.summary: Your next attack will fire twice in quick succession with increased damage and velocity. This attack consumes extra ammo.

items.name: Headhunter
items.summary: Your next headshot against an enemy Hero deals bonus weapon damage , heal you, and briefly grants bonus move speed .

items.name: Heroic Aura
items.summary: Provides move speed and fire rate to you and nearby allies. Minions get double value.

items.name: Hollow Point
items.summary: When you are above 65% health , deal additional Weapon Damage and your bullets reduce enemy Bullet Resist .

items.name: Hunter's Aura
items.summary: Reduces nearby enemies' Bullet Resist and Fire Rate . If there is only one enemy hero nearby, this effect is doubled .

items.name: Point Blank
items.summary: When in close range to your target, gain Weapon Damage and your bullets apply a Movement Slow .

items.name: Shadow Weave
items.summary: Attacking or using an ability will end your stealth and start an ambush , temporarily granting you bonus Weapon Damage and Spirit Power .

items.name: Sharpshooter
items.summary: Deal additional Weapon Damage when beyond a minimum distance from your target.

items.name: Tesla Bullets
items.summary: Your bullets have a chance to shock your target. The shock will jump to a nearby enemy.

items.name: Toxic Bullets
items.summary: Your bullets build up a Bleed on enemies, causing them to lose a percentage of their Max Health over time. Also reduces Incoming Healing on the bleeding target.

items.name: Weighted Shots
items.summary: Your bullets build up a Movement Slow on enemies.

items.name: Armor Piercer
items.summary: Your Bullets have a chance to become unavoidable, piercing through enemies and ignoring their Bullet Resistance .

items.name: Capacitor
items.summary: Launch a projectile that deals damage , applies a strong slow that recovers over time, prevents Stamina usage and Silences their movement-based items and abilities .

items.name: Crippling Headshot
items.summary: Landing a Headshot will reduce their Bullet, Spirit Resist, and Incoming Healing .

items.name: Crushing Fists
items.summary: Your melee damage will restore ammo and apply a stacking bullet resist debuff on enemies. Heavy melee applies 2 stacks. If the target reaches max stacks, they will be stunned .

items.name: Frenzy
items.summary: While you are below 50% health , you gain stat bonuses for a duration and existing debuffs on you are reduced.

items.name: Glass Cannon
items.summary: Each hero kill grants permanent Fire Rate (up to a max of 8 times). Death results in the loss of 1 stack.

items.name: Lucky Shot
items.summary: Your bullets have a chance to be empowered, causing them to deal bonus weapon damage on hit. Bonus damage cannot Crit.

items.name: Ricochet
items.summary: Your bullets will ricochet on enemies near your target, applying any bullet procs and dealing a percentage of the original damage.

items.name: Silencer
items.summary: Your bullets build up to a Silence . Victims are immune to the build up for 10s after silence expires.

items.name: Spellslinger
items.summary: While in-combat whenever you cast an ability or item, gain a stacking buff that improves fire rate and reload speed. Each stack refreshes the duration.

items.name: Spiritual Overflow
items.summary: Gain bonus Fire Rate , Spirit Power and Spirit Lifesteal by charging up when shooting heroes.
